en: An old, hand‑colored multi‑view postcard with three framed scenes and floral Art Nouveau ornament. The left image shows a small town with a church featuring a tall tower and spire above red‑roofed houses. The upper central image shows a large inn or guesthouse with arches at the ground level and the sign "Gasthof Polenz Albin Jeheber" on the facade, with figures and carts in front. The right image depicts a rural landscape with fields and a stand of trees. In the center of the card is the printed greeting "Gruss aus Polenz." The lower margin contains publisher information and a note that it is a hand‑colored artist card.
